regla_de_decision.evidencia: Decision rule: ordinary decisions are approved by absolute majority (at least 4 of the 7 participants in favor). Decisions concerning the custody, reserve and allocation policy of the boat or the medicines require a qualified majority of at least 5 of 7.

regimen_de_propiedad.evidencia: Tools and rescued goods are common; custodians replaceable by absolute majority. Personal effects are private.

sistema_economico.evidencia: Everyone contributes work according to capacity and receives a full basic ration; surplus is distributed proportionally to work.

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: Disputes: parties first seek agreement with Party 5 mediating within two days; failing that, the assembly decides by absolute majority after hearing both sides; anyone personally involved, including Party 5, does not mediate or vote.

castigo.evidencia: Penalties: only for written rules, proportional, decided by the assembly after hearing the accused: warning, extra work, loss of surplus share, suspension from role.

salida.evidencia: Rights: basic ration, water, shelter, medical care within policy, consultation of all records, being heard before any decision affecting oneself, leaving freely.

principio_distributivo.evidencia: Everyone contributes work according to capacity and receives a full basic ration; surplus is distributed proportionally to work.

medicamentos.evidencia: Urgent medical treatment may be administered by the person with medical training within the approved policy, and must be reported publicly at the next deliberation; any treatment for that person's own condition is decided by the group.

bote.evidencia: Boat secured by custodian, leaves only by 5-of-7 decision with rower aboard; custodian may postpone for weather or safety, reporting to assembly.

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: Extraction follows quotas approved within three days, using Party 4's monthly written inventory, public and verifiable; until then, gathering for immediate food is free. Quotas bind everyone, custodians included.

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: Tools and rescued goods are common; custodians replaceable by absolute majority. Personal effects are private. Whoever leaves takes personal effects and a fair share of stored food, never medicines, tools or the boat.

proteccion_ambiental.evidencia: Prohibited: felling fruit trees, hunting breeding animals, extracting coal or metal beyond quota.
